art_note: The imagery relies heavily on flat mockups and composite model shots that detract from a luxury feel.
desc_en: A sober and polished presence defines this impeccably tailored blazer. Designed to project serene distinction with every movement. Features notched lapels and a two-button front closure. Complete with two patch pockets and a back vent for ease of movement. An essential piece for formal occasions and events.
desc_es: Una presencia sobria y pulida define esta americana de corte impecable. Diseñada para proyectar distinción serena en cada movimiento. Con solapas de muesca y cierre frontal de dos botones. Incorpora dos bolsillos de parche y una abertura posterior para mayor holgura. Una pieza esencial para ocasiones formales y eventos.
details_en:
· Polyester fabric with soft inner lining (22.86 oz)
· Two-button front closure and notched lapels
· Back vent and long sleeves with buttoned cuffs
· Two patch pockets
· Hand or machine wash
· Made-to-order
· Worldwide shipping available
details_es:
· Tejido de poliéster con forro interior suave (22.86 oz)
· Cierre frontal de dos botones y solapas de muesca
· Abertura posterior y mangas largas con puños abotonados
· Dos bolsillos de parche
· Lavar a mano o a máquina
